quarterly_data.signal: H1 2026 (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026, consolidated, reviewed by Shinhan Accounting Corp.): revenue KRW 936,936M vs KRW 644,365M in H1 2025 (+45.4%); gross profit KRW 139,029M (14.8% GM vs 7.2%); SG&A KRW 62,428M; operating profit KRW 76,601M (8.2% margin) vs a KRW -10,780M loss; finance income KRW 78,968M (FX gains KRW 21,437M + FX translation gains KRW 46,444M) against finance costs KRW 73,313M (interest KRW 17,970M, FX losses KRW 22,585M, translation losses KRW 27,089M, derivative valuation loss KRW 4,397M); pre-tax KRW 83,573M; tax KRW 24,182M (estimated annual effective rate 28.9%); net income KRW 59,391M; basic EPS KRW 1,586 vs KRW -1,702. Q2 alone: revenue KRW 514,565M (+51.0% YoY), gross profit KRW 95,153M (18.5% GM), OP KRW 62,890M (12.2%), NI KRW 44,945M, EPS KRW 1,195 - the second consecutive profitable quarter after FY2025 (revenue KRW 1,410,560M, OP KRW 11,869M, net loss KRW -164,580M) and FY2024 (revenue KRW 1,231,421M, OP loss KRW -46,969M). MIX (H1): Package Substrate KRW 711,717M = 76.0% of revenue (export KRW 609,259M, domestic KRW 102,458M); Memory Module PCB KRW 225,219M = 24.0% (export KRW 209,001M, domestic KRW 16,218M); exports incl. local L/C sales KRW 818,260M = 87.3%, domestic 12.7%. Blended ASP KRW 1,464,416 per square metre in H1 2026 vs KRW 1,127,062 for FY2025 (+29.9%) and KRW 1,084,616 for FY2024 - the price recovery plus a richer high-value product mix drives the margin swing. SUBSIDIARIES: Shintae Electronics (Xi'an, China, memory-module PCB) H1 revenue KRW 144,070M (vs KRW 123,758M), net income KRW 851M (vs KRW 8,192M); Simmtech Graphics (Chino, Nagano, Japan, MSAP substrates) H1 revenue KRW 94,514M (vs KRW 51,854M, +82%), net loss narrowed to KRW -3,421M from KRW -14,871M. Parent-only (separate) H1: revenue KRW 700,709M, OP KRW 70,282M, NI KRW 56,902M. BALANCE SHEET at 2026-06-30: total assets KRW 1,840,115M (vs KRW 1,620,330M at 2025-12-31); cash KRW 91,056M; trade and other receivables KRW 496,804M (+18%); inventories KRW 290,086M (vs KRW 239,838M) after a KRW 26,730M inventory write-down charged in H1; borrowings KRW 551,756M plus bonds KRW 172,461M; net debt KRW 633,161M, net-debt-to-equity 97.4% (vs 91.2%), debt-to-equity 183.1%; equity KRW 649,985M. Operating cash flow KRW -47,331M (vs KRW -120,866M) as receivables (+KRW 74,745M) and inventories (+KRW 70,964M) were built for the ramp; PP&E purchases KRW 34,110M (vs KRW 8,869M). Financing +KRW 91,652M, mainly three private bond issues totalling KRW 115,000M (8th KRW 45,000M on 02-11-2026, 9th KRW 20,000M on 04-30-2026, 10th KRW 50,000M on 05-29-2026; all 6.5% coupon, 4-year, investor put), less a KRW 7,619M treasury-share buyback and a KRW 3,733M dividend (KRW 100 per share for FY2025). Employees 3,047 at 2026-06-30.

quarterly_data.signal: Orders and customers (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026, as of 2026-06-30): order book for 2026-01~2026-06 - total orders (year-end 2025 backlog plus H1 new orders) 1,068,667 square metres / USD 998,848K, of which 689,415 square metres / USD 606,493K were delivered in H1, leaving an ORDER BACKLOG of 379,251 square metres / USD 392,355K (roughly 0.65x H1 deliveries). Contract liabilities (customer prepayments) fell to KRW 8,037M from KRW 19,303M at year-end. CUSTOMER CONCENTRATION: the anonymised table shows A 31.7%, B 16.7%, C 13.6%, others 38.0% of H1 revenue; the segment note names them - SAMSUNG ELECTRONICS KRW 130,331M (31% of H1 revenue, down from KRW 173,434M / 57% in H1 2025, -25% YoY), SK HYNIX KRW 71,870M (17%, up from KRW 44,645M / 15%, +61% YoY) and MICRON TECHNOLOGY KRW 60,916M (14%, up from KRW 43,180M / 14%, +41% YoY) - so the top-3 memory makers are 62% of sales and the customer base broadened sharply (top-3 were 86% a year ago). The filing states customers include the global 'Big 5' memory makers (Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, a US chipmaker and others), the 'Big 5' packaging houses (ASE, Amkor, SPIL, JCET, PTI) and global fabless companies, with Simmtech positioned as 'First PCB Vendor' and strategic partner doing joint early development; end-markets PC, server, smart mobile, SSD, wearables, automotive. Company claims ~30% global share in memory-module PCB and BoC substrates for years and the world's #1 share in GDDR substrates (a 'World-Class Product' since 2023-11). Sales channels H1: direct export KRW 516,260M (55.1%, paid within 90 days), local L/C export KRW 302,000M (32.2%, 10 days), domestic KRW 118,676M (12.7%, ~90 days); overseas sales are booked through the group sales entity SIMMTECH INTERNATIONAL PTE. LTD. (KRW 306,474M of consolidated related-party sales in H1). Future-receivable securitisation programmes are pledged on the two Korean customers: Samsung Electronics future receivables (KRW 332,437M over two years) backing a KRW 60,000M ABCP/AB loan issued 2024-09-27 (KRW 7,500M outstanding) and SK Hynix future receivables (KRW 279,042M over two years) backing a KRW 47,000M ABL loan issued 2025-04-29 (KRW 23,500M outstanding). Korean peer revenue for 2025 (separate basis): Simmtech KRW 1,097.1B vs Daeduck Electronics KRW 1,064.7B, Korea Circuit KRW 863.0B, TLB KRW 260.3B.

quarterly_data.signal: Capacity, utilisation and capex (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): H1 2026 production capacity 846,000 square metres - HDI division (memory-module PCB) 264,000 square metres (44,000 per month) and SPS division (package substrates) 582,000 square metres (97,000 per month); annualised capacity of 1,692,000 square metres is unchanged from 2025 and 2024. H1 output 680,271 square metres (HDI 194,300; SPS 485,970) = 80.41% UTILISATION, running 21 hours a day on two shifts; SPS output annualises to ~972,000 square metres vs 818,540 in all of 2025 (+19%) and 684,898 in 2024, while HDI annualises to ~389,000 vs 464,796 in 2025 - substrate lines are the ones filling up. Sites: six plants plus an R&D centre in Korea (Cheongju/Ochang), Shintae Electronics in Xi'an, China (memory-module line, 15,000 square metres per month when built), Simmtech Graphics in Chino, Nagano, Japan (MSAP substrate lines), T.E. Tech inspection in Rawang, Malaysia, and the related-party SUSTIO SDN. BHD. PCB plant in Penang, Malaysia (68.6% owned by group entity Simmtech International, not consolidated; Simmtech guarantees USD 22M of its UOB Malaysia borrowings, extended 04-29-2026, and is selling it KRW 5,250M of machinery held for sale). PP&E additions in H1 KRW 65,260M (machinery +KRW 49,179M: Korea KRW 31,928M, Xi'an KRW 11,527M, Japan KRW 5,601M; buildings +KRW 7,992M incl. Xi'an KRW 5,192M); construction-in-progress fell from KRW 56,493M to KRW 35,313M as KRW 32,006M of equipment went into service (Korea CIP KRW 30,170M remaining); depreciation KRW 49,491M; PP&E net KRW 566,193M. The filing states there are NO plans for new facility construction or purchase at present, and the 2024 KRW 120B CB/BW programme earmarked for System-IC substrate capacity (2024-2025) is complete. Financing for the next phase: on 06-22-2026 the board approved a new secured borrowing from Korea Development Bank as manager of the Advanced Strategic Industry Fund; KDB holds KRW 160,000M of collateral on the Cheongju plants and a KRW 65.2B (JPY) syndicate lien sits on the Japanese plant. A 'Global Site construction advisor' (ex-architect) remains on the executive roster.

quarterly_data.signal: New products, R&D and corporate catalysts (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): R&D spend H1 KRW 29,224M = 3.12% of revenue (FY2025 KRW 48,221M / 3.42%; FY2024 KRW 23,587M / 1.92%) with 122 R&D staff and 149 registered patents. Pipeline IN DEVELOPMENT: 2.xD substrates (2.3D interposer RDL substrate and 2.1D package substrate), Glass Core Substrate / glass interposer (multi-layer glass interposer technology), Glass Core FC-BGA process, Thick-Cu substrate (70um pattern for heat dissipation), through-hole Cu filling for thermal performance, and PID material evaluation (using semiconductor RDL material as PCB dielectric). COMPLETED: High Layer Slim FCBGA (transition from high-layer ABF FCBGA to slim FCBGA), high-layer coreless, hybrid ultra-thin coreless (PPG+RCC), Cu-post / high-height Cu-post and Cu-post interposer, embedded die, embedded active + cavity, both-side cavity, AiP high-layer / mmWave AiP, RF-SiP via ALD, PMIC substrate, heatsink substrate, thermal bar/chunk via, thin-seed sputter fine-line. Patents granted in 2026 include a TGV glass substrate with resin-filled vias (03-18-2026), a heat-dissipation-via PCB (01-15-2026) and a package structure (06-04-2026). Stated strategy: shift from memory-centric products toward high-value System-IC substrates (FC-CSP, SiP module) with new customers. Market framing: Prismark (Aug 2026) puts the 2026 PCB market at USD 102.0B (+18.8%) with Packaging substrates the fastest segment at USD 19.2B (+28.9%) and Computing USD 27.9B (+25.9%); 2030 outlook USD 140.5B (10.4% CAGR). MANAGEMENT: Song Ho-geon (UC Berkeley PhD, formerly Samsung Electronics TSP) joined ~Q2 2026 as Executive CTO alongside a new manufacturing head Son Gil-dong (ex-LG) and an 'AI equipment group'; co-CEOs Jeon Young-sun and Kim Young-gu (Kim re-elected 03-26-2026 to 2029-03). An RSU plan approved 05-19-2026 grants 40,000 shares (30,000-60,000 depending on 2026 operating-profit attainment vs plan) to 16 executives, payable 2027-04 from treasury shares (58,692 shares bought 06-19~06-25-2026 for KRW 7,596M). CAPITAL STRUCTURE: the 4th CB (KRW 100B) was fully converted by 04-24-2026 (last tranche at KRW 30,276) and the 5th BW (KRW 20B) by 12-11-2025, lifting shares outstanding to 37,463,931; the 7th perpetual subordinated CB (KRW 50B, 4%, conversion price KRW 21,556, 2,319,539 shares) saw KRW 11B converted after 06-30-2026, leaving KRW 39B at the 08-13-2026 filing date (KRW 16.5B held by parent Simmtech Holdings after its 06-05-2026 call, KRW 22.5B by investors). Simmtech Holdings' stake fell to 32.43% from 33.19% after it issued exchangeable bonds on 04-22-2026. Credit rating from eCredible cut to B+ (05-08-2026) from BB- (04-14-2025) with a D cash-flow grade. Share price averaged KRW 121,314 in June 2026 (high KRW 148,700) vs KRW 50,238 in January 2026; H1 total shareholder return 190.7%.
quarterly_data.figure: Glass-core substrate/interposer, glass FC-BGA and 2.3D/2.1D interposer substrates in development; Slim FCBGA done; R&D KRW 29.2B (3.1% of rev); ex-Samsung CTO hired; KRW 39B perpetual CB left; rating B+ (05-08-2026)

quarterly_data.signal: Raw materials, suppliers and inventories (DART half-year report filed 08-13-2026): H1 2026 raw and sub-material purchases KRW 467,654M (= 49.9% of revenue) vs KRW 722,759M for all of 2025. By item: POTASSIUM GOLD CYANIDE (gold plating salt) KRW 168,616M = 36.1% of purchases, supplier Heesung Catalysts Corp., price KRW 154,945 per gram vs KRW 108,721 in 2025 (+42.5%) and KRW 70,719 in 2024 - gold is now the single largest input cost; COPPER CLAD LAMINATE KRW 97,340M (20.8%), suppliers LG Chem and Doosan Electronics (Gimcheon), KRW 13,059 per panel (+14.2% vs 2025); PREPREG KRW 61,144M (13.1%), Doosan Electronics (Gimcheon), KRW 5,369 per sheet (+14.7%); COPPER FOIL KRW 13,601M (2.9%), Mitsui & Co. Ltd., KRW 2,292 per sheet; other raw materials incl. copper anode KRW 38,564M (8.2%), Taiyo Ink Products; sub-materials incl. drill bits KRW 88,389M (18.9%), Atotech Korea. All suppliers are stated to be independent (no affiliate, JV or shareholding ties); price drivers cited are USD/JPY exchange rates, supply-demand and the rising share of high-value products. Localisation of formerly imported materials is 'substantially' complete and the supplier base is being diversified. Inventories KRW 290,086M at 2026-06-30 (gross KRW 352,329M less a KRW 62,243M valuation allowance, up from KRW 35,323M at year-end): SPS division KRW 182,328M (raw materials KRW 84,701M, WIP KRW 61,236M), HDI division KRW 107,758M; inventory turnover 6.02x (5.71x in 2025); inventories pledged to Korea Eximbank for USD 46.8M of loans; physical count 07-06-2026 at the Cheongju and Ochang plants. Simmtech is a Phase-4 (2026-2030) emissions-trading allocation entity with 110,394 tCO2-eq emitted in 2025.
